$Comment: The skill curve: levels 1 to 200 on the hybrid formula, each level costing the OSRS sum of floor(l + 200 * 2^(l / 7)) over the levels below, quartered, plus 300 * level * (level - 1) / 2. Level 50 takes about 435 thousand, 100 about 11.1 million, 120 about 72 million and 200 about 190 billion. Pace is what a focused hour of play earns from each level on, rising in bands: at it, level 50 comes after about 12 hours, 90 after 62 and 100 after about 121. A reward priced in minutes pays that many minutes of the band the level it is priced at stands in. A track names it with "Curve": "Skill_Hybrid"; a pack's own same-id file replaces it, a pack's curve with "Parent": "Skill_Hybrid" adds or retunes one band by its level, and a track wanting another shape names a curve of its own.
